1:
That Section 8 of the Alcohol Ordinance is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following language is inserted in lieu thereof:

- (a) Age, character: citizen. No person shall be granted a license to engage in the sale and/or distribution of alcoholic beverages within the Town unless it shall appear to the satisfaction of the Council of the Town of Pine Mountain that such person is of legal age, of good moral character, a citizen of the United States, and a permanent resident of Harris County, Georgia for the twelve-month period immediately preceding the application or has designated a permanent resident of Harris County, Georgia for the twelve-month period immediately preceding the application that shall be responsible for any matter relating to the license, and meets all other conditions cited in this Ordinance. Proof of permanent residence in Harris County, Georgia shall be established by the production of a valid Georgia driver’s license evidencing permanent residency in Harris County, Georgia and such other

evidence as may be required by the Clerk of the Council of the Town of Pine Mountain in the exercise of his or her reasonable discretion.

- (b) No conviction or violation of law. The licensee shall not (i) have a pending felony or fingerprintable misdemeanor charge or (ii) have been convicted or taken or entered a plea of nolo contendere, within ten (10) years immediately prior to filing of such application for any felony violation of the laws of this state or any other state or five (5) years for any fingerprintable misdemeanor violation of the laws of this state or any other state.
2:
That Section 18 of the Alcohol Ordinance is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following language is inserted in lieu thereof:

The Chief of Police of the Town of Pine Mountain and his authorized officers are hereby authorized to exercise enforcement, investigative, and seizure powers and duties with respect to this Ordinance to control and regulate the sale and use of alcoholic beverages and to issue citations for violations of this Ordinance, which citations shall be returnable and heard in the Municipal Court of Pine Mountain. Any person convicted of violating this Ordinance or any portion thereof shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and shall be punished by a fine not to exceed $1,000.00 or imprisonment in the Harris County Jail for six months or both. Each day of any violation of this Ordinance shall continue and shall constitute a separate offense punishable as provided herein.
3: That all ordinances or parts of ordinances in conflict herewith are hereby expressly repealed.
4:
That this amendment shall become effective on _ August 9 , 2021.
